admission.justification: The gate spans the policy, the record checker and the shipped record, is proven by two host cases, and the mistake it prevents — serving generated script off an unproven policy — is the exact failure the requirement exists for.

applicability: Every generated page served by the canvas host on a live session.
conditions: The shipped proof record is readable and names the policy digest now served.
The record's enforcement bindings name the enforcement modules' own current bytes.
exclusions: A page examined by the static readiness check, which executes nothing.
A record produced for a different policy digest.
statement: A generated page executes script only under a served isolation policy the shipped proof record covers: the policy digest, the enforcement source bindings and every required browser check with its observed value must hold, and a policy any of them does not cover is served with no script at all.
